name: Service van
description: A boxy white autonomous electric service van with a black glass front, roof sensors and light bars: the rules' truck.

made_with.settings: multi-image (main and side views), textured, PBR

notes: Prepared with tools/prep_prop.py. 4.91 m long, 2.8 m tall with its sensors. Full resolution, 913,030 triangles: collapsing to 40,000 made the panels rough (Bryson, 2026-10-11). --glow 2: the red lights glow. tools/build_fixtures.py adds the OpenBrain emblem to both flanks as decals, from the prepared model kept in sources.
